Name: Tool Upgrade Delivery
Author: SorryLate
Description:
[b]Tool Upgrade Delivery
[/b]this mod will send your tool upgrade in your inventory when it's done.
Honestly i want to make it like Tool-Upgrade Delivery Service since it's broken, but i still can't found how to attach a item in mail. So, i make this version.

[b]How to use :[/b]
By default this mod will check if you have tool upgrade or not, if you have this mod will try to send it to your inventory.
You can press F3 to receive your upgrade, this is so useful when you miss your upgrade because of inventory was full.

[b]Config :
[/b]ReceiveUpgradeButton : default is F3.
InstantUpgrade : default is false.
CostInstantUpgrade : price for instant upgrade, default is 5000.

[b]Question :
[/b]Q : What happen if my inventory full? i lost my tool?
A : No, your tool still in Clint. you can take it by pressing F3 or you can take it manually from Clint or you can wait to the next day. this mod will try to send your tool again.
---
Q : This mod compatible with Rush Orders?
A : I don't know i didn't test it, but if you using Rush Orders you can tell me it's compatible or not :3

[b]Compatible :
[/b]Shop Anywhere.
